categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Bayi Space LCD Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of display materials, semiconductor materials, and pharmaceutical materials. Its main business focuses on liquid crystal display materials, including liquid crystal materials, polymer dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC) smart films, and organic electroluminescent (OLED) materials. The company also develops semiconductor materials such as photoresist resin and polyimide (PSPI) materials, as well as advanced pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including molecular simulation and design for liquid crystals, low-temperature reaction technology, novel catalyst coupling reactions, hydrogenation, short-path molecular distillation, column chromatography, high vacuum distillation, and micro-impurity analysis and control. It has proprietary formula development software and industrial-scale purification techniques such as high vacuum sublimation for OLED materials. For semiconductor photoresist resins, it controls polymer molecular weight and distribution precisely. The company also employs digitalized production management systems like MES and NC ERP for efficient and quality-controlled manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major LCD panel manufacturers such as BOE Technology Group, HKC, and Innolux. The company serves industries producing mobile phones, notebooks, monitors, TVs, and automotive displays. It also targets semiconductor manufacturers for photoresist materials and pharmaceutical companies for intermediates and APIs. The automotive sector, especially new energy vehicles with advanced display needs, is a growing market segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Zhejiang, and Hebei provinces. It has established overseas subsidiaries in Japan, Hong Kong, and Zimbabwe to support international R&D and sales. The company is expanding its overseas market presence, particularly for OLED materials and automotive display materials.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bayi Space operates mainly upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a producer of core electronic materials such as liquid crystal compounds, photoresist resins, and pharmaceutical intermediates. It supplies these specialized materials to downstream panel manufacturers, semiconductor fabs, and pharmaceutical producers, playing a critical role in the materials supply chain for display and semiconductor industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment focused on high-performance TFT liquid crystal materials, OLED materials, photoresist resins, PSPI materials, and pharmaceutical intermediates. It pursues breakthroughs in molecular design, purity, and performance to meet evolving market demands, including automotive and high-end display applications. The company also invests in digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized electronic materials including mixed liquid crystals, liquid crystal monomers, OLED materials, photoresist resins, and pharmaceutical intermediates. Sales are mainly conducted via direct contracts with large panel manufacturers and semiconductor companies, with some products sold through distributors. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bayi Space is one of the leading domestic suppliers of TFT mixed liquid crystal materials in China, recognized as a strategic supplier to major panel makers like BOE. It is among the top three domestic companies breaking foreign monopolies in liquid crystal materials. In semiconductor photoresist resins, it is an important domestic player advancing high-end product development. The company holds a strong market position domestically with growing international recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 737 million, a 7.77% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 76.6 million, down 28.27%. Total assets reached RMB 2.9 billion with steady growth in fixed assets and R&D investment, which increased by 12.5% to RMB 88 million. The company is in a rapid development phase, expanding production capacity and diversifying its product portfolio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bayi Space emphasizes high-quality, high-performance, and technologically advanced electronic materials with strong customization capabilities tailored to client needs. It leverages proprietary technologies and a robust R&D system to deliver products that meet stringent international standards, breaking foreign technology monopolies. The company offers comprehensive customer support including technical services and residual image analysis, ensuring product reliability and fostering long-term strategic partnerships.
